body:
did you know taylor just set a record that had stood since 1961?

on billboard's adult contemporary chart, she became the first artist in history to hold four of the top 10 at the same time -- "the fate of ophelia," "opalite," "elizabeth taylor," and "i knew it, i knew you."

the only act ever to come close did it with a christmas album -- a format that plays by its own rules. strip the tinsel out, and the top of adult contemporary had never belonged to one artist four times over. until now.

and these aren't all from one record: three are from the life of a showgirl, one is from the toy story 5 soundtrack. adult contemporary is a slow chart -- songs climb it over months and stay -- so four at once isn't a launch. it's an accumulation. four separate releases, all still working at the same time.

longlivets.com
why: IG version of the AC chart-record did-you-know. Same vault + Billboard sourcing as the X draft; all four song titles and the christmas-album caveat trace to the vault TLOAS chart page.
